title: Terminal restore on failure: correct — cleanup in main runs even on run_app Err
description: main.rs structure: enable_raw_mode, then cleanup block that always runs (not in a defer but explicitly before result?), then run_app. The fix in loop 6 placed cleanup AFTER run_app returns and used let _ = ignore errors on cleanup calls. This is correct: the result? happens after cleanup so even if run_app returns Err, disable_raw_mode and LeaveAlternateScreen run. A future contributor might try to 'simplify' by using a RAII guard — the explicit cleanup is actually safer because RAII guard drop order can be surprising. The panic hook also covers the panic path. Defend this pattern.
